title: Shopify
description: A product for a Shopify store card: rotates in 3D and opens in augmented reality. What matters most is fast loading in the storefront and a clean product look.

fileMB.note: Рекомендация «about 4 MB» — 3D model standards checklist. Потолок 15 МБ: выше Shopify оптимизирует файл сам, не спрашивая

materials.note: «There is only one material assigned to the model, unless otherwise necessary»

textureMaxSize.note: Текстуры «shouldn’t be larger than 2048 x 2048 px». Ядро пока не отдаёт размерность текстур — не проверяется

triangles.note: источника нет: Shopify числа треугольников не называет, только «как можно меньше»

drawCalls.note: источника нет: Shopify об отрисовках не пишет

availableExtensions.title: Safe optimizations
availableExtensions.description: Lossless cleanup: dedup materials/textures, remove unused data, weld identical vertices, drop degenerate and orphan geometry. Shape and materials are not changed.
availableExtensions.impact: Smaller file with no visible change.

availableExtensions.title: Meshopt compression
availableExtensions.description: Compresses geometry with Meshopt — smaller file that unpacks quickly on the GPU. A good default for the web.
availableExtensions.impact: Noticeably smaller geometry; fast decode in the browser.

availableExtensions.title: Join meshes
availableExtensions.description: Merges separate parts into one mesh — fewer draw calls. Structural: individual parts cannot be restored from the result.
availableExtensions.impact: Fewer draw calls; parts are merged (irreversible).

availableExtensions.title: GPU instancing
availableExtensions.description: Turns repeated meshes into copies drawn by the graphics card — fewer separate draws per frame. The store's viewer has to support this.
availableExtensions.impact: Fewer draw calls when the scene repeats meshes.

availableExtensions.title: Resample
availableExtensions.description: Removes redundant animation keyframes without changing the motion — smaller animation data.

availableExtensions.title: KTX2 compression
availableExtensions.description: Converts textures to a format the graphics card keeps compressed: up to ~80% less video memory. The store's viewer has to be able to open such textures — without that the model will not show.
availableExtensions.impact: The file may grow 5–10%, but texture video memory drops several-fold.

description.en: Repacks the model's textures so the file gets smaller — video memory stays the same. Textures already prepared for the graphics card are left alone. The store's viewer needs nothing extra to open this.
description.ru: Пережимает текстуры модели — файл становится меньше, видеопамяти нужно столько же. Текстуры, уже подготовленные для видеокарты, остаются как есть. Витрине магазина ничего доустанавливать не нужно.

impact.en: Smaller download — the page opens faster. Video memory is unchanged: WebP is unpacked before it reaches the GPU.
impact.ru: Файл меньше — страница открывается быстрее. Видеопамять не меняется: WebP распаковывается до попадания в видеокарту.

availableExtensions.title: Draco compression
availableExtensions.description: Minimal file weight (often −50% on geometry). Decodes slower than Meshopt in the browser but is supported everywhere.
availableExtensions.impact: The file is noticeably lighter; decoding on open is slower.

availableExtensions.title: Quantization
availableExtensions.description: Quantization means writing vertex coordinates with fewer digits: instead of a long precise number, a shorter approximate one. The geometry gets lighter and the store's viewer needs nothing extra to open it — unlike Draco and Meshopt. Coordinates become slightly coarser: on a small detailed model that can show up as tiny gaps.
availableExtensions.impact: Geometry drops by a third to a half. The gain shows up in the file only when the weight is in the geometry, not in the textures.

availableExtensions.title: Remove vertex colors
availableExtensions.description: Removes painted vertex colors. Enable only if vertex colors are not visible in the model (white channels are removed without this option too).
availableExtensions.impact: Saves 5–20% of size if colors exist; may change the look if they were used.

notes: Числа сверены с документацией Shopify 2026-07-29. Подтверждены размер файла, материалы и текстуры.

fileMB: warn 4 (рекомендация Shopify), limit 15 (жёсткий предел — выше площадка пережимает файл сама). Это единственный профиль, где есть limit: витрина действительно отклоняет, в отличие от голого Three.js.
triangles, drawCalls, vramMB порогов не имеют — Shopify их не называет. Значения показываются без оценки.
